acceptance_criteria: fault-injected short append and sync failure with boundary restoration; CHK-11, NEG-12, NEG-14.
statement: If a storage append reports fewer bytes than requested (partial write) or a transient write/sync failure, the journal **shall** fail closed: it **shall** attempt to restore the last complete frame boundary (truncate to the last known-good offset) and, if it cannot, **shall** mark the journal unusable for further appends and report `PartialWrite`/`WriteFailed`; it **shall** never count a partial frame as a retained record.
title: T026 requirement 009
verification_intent: fault-injected short append and sync failure with boundary restoration; CHK-11, NEG-12, NEG-14.
